newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU TO STREAMLINE DUTCH MAGAZINES BUSINESS.
newsitem.headline: VNU TO STREAMLINE DUTCH MAGAZINES BUSINESS.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Monday it planned to streamline its Dutch consumer magazines business.
VNU said the move would involve merging its three separate Dutch consumer magazine subsidiaries: De Geillustreerde Pers, Uitgeverij Spaarnestad and VNU TelePress Publications.

VNU -- which dominates the Dutch consumer magazines market -- said the operation was aimed at boosting efficiency and flexibility and enabling the company to reach readers and advertisers more effectively.
VNU said it would regroup its Dutch magazines operation into 10 business units, most of which will correspond to a target readership such as children or young women.
Staff, currently dispersed over four sites, will be brought together in one location but advertising sales will be decentralised in line with the new business unit structure.
About 70 jobs out of a total of 1,200 will be phased out over a period of two to three years.
